title: Where We Got To
brief: The end-of-section summary. Then two kinetic-type shots — practice on the platform, and an invitation to build alongside. Light showroom skin, Kokoro af_heart narration kept on the file.
angle: You are further along than you think, and here is what the rest of the road looks like.

segments.prompt: What has been finished — Claude Desktop installed, the first Python project running as a shopping web app — against what is coming: customizing, authorization and getting data

beats.heading: What we have built
beats.narration: Okay, let's summarize what we've learned so far. We have installed Claude Desktop on our machines, and we have successfully set up our first Python project, which is a web application for an online shopping application.

beats.heading: What comes next
beats.narration: Moving forward, we'll go a little deeper into how we can customize our application. We'll also look at authorization, getting data, and other important aspects of building a complete application.

segments.prompt: Two closing shots: practice with the exercises on the platform, and build alongside me so we learn by doing

beats.heading: Practice the exercises
beats.narration: For now, just keep these concepts in mind and make sure you practice using the exercises available on our platform. Hopefully, everything makes sense so far.

beats.heading: Build alongside me
beats.narration: Moving forward, I recommend that you try building alongside me, if possible, so that we can streamline our no-code development process and learn by doing.
